title: nephrolepis multifida
intro: Nephrolepis multifida, commonly known as Boston Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Lomariopsidaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Boston Fern include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic actions, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Boston Fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
